description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Update lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex runtime/provider specs, connection preparation/identity, listener opts, status/logout and outbound options; lib/zaq/channels/bridge.ex fetch_connection_details_for_config; lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/state.ex lifecycle handling only where needed. Route through shared Adapter wrappers, retain listener_child_specs and existing supervisor machinery. Base Bridge delegates to configured bridge for connection details; preserve non-Jido bridge defaults. Consume opaque adapter options/identity without constructing profile/storage details. Trust policy from host config, not persisted ingress; package translates history/RAM flags. Preserve provider startup before provisional pairing, saved restore and listener restart semantics. Generalize lifecycle guards by supported contract rather than :linked_device special-case when appropriate, keeping original source/attempt checks.

Tests to add before implementation:
Use runtime_contracts_test.exs, connector_disable_test.exs, jido_chat_delivery_test.exs, jido_chat_bridge_test.exs and jido_chat_bridge/whatsapp_lifecycle_ingress_test.exs. Add non-WhatsApp contract adapter integration, legacy Telegram/Mattermost/no-callback defaults, startup options precedence, provider-runtime once-only, startup cleanup/restart, no-state start recursion, every outbound operation retaining exact connector scope. Prove QR update before sink ack, stale source/attempt rejection, source death, redacted status and explicit logout vs stop. Test identity resolution on cold/stopped connectors and unsupported/no-identity errors without profile fallback.

Branches/paths validated:
Enabled/disabled/archived bootstrap; fresh/prepared/cold connection; absent optional methods; stopped listener and failed logout; concurrent profiles; shared infrastructure replacement; new source vs stale process exit; unrelated providers retain runtime and restart behavior.

Mocking plan:
Real BridgeSupervisor/State and generic wrappers; use real adapter with fake external transport and a conformance adapter for provider-neutrality. Async-safe dependency configuration; isolate genuinely global OTP storage.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Channels service runtime/bridge/state contracts and package option docs; remove stale WhatsApp-shaped orchestration descriptions and hardcoded generic status wording. No product UI change.

Action reuse assessment:
EXTEND existing Bridge/JidoChatBridge contract and REUSE CommunicationBridge.sync_config_runtime, BridgeSupervisor and existing logout authorization/action path. LOCAL-ONLY specs/preparation and option forwarding; no new executable Action or tool. Verify consumers use selected adapter and preserve all existing authorization/storage boundaries.

Required policy and epic constraints:
Read this epic before starting. Read each affected repository's AGENTS.md. In ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md and applicable docs/conventions.md; before documentation edits read docs/documentation.md. Run bw prime and verify live source/Git/dependency state. Use Serena for source relationships and Context Mode for large output. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md#phase-4--validate and its final validation/coverage lifecycle rather than treating this ticket as an alternative policy. No existing test behavior change is approved by this plan. No new feature E2E is planned: this is a behavior-preserving boundary refactor with no UI change. Reassess that decision if scope expands.

comments.text: Base Bridge delegates connection details to configured bridge callback. Jido bridge consumes core runtime/preparation/identity/options/logout wrappers; WhatsApp storage runtime/profile/history flags removed from orchestration. Non-WhatsApp conformance test proves opaque tuple scope, delivery with no profile and lifecycle updates on webhook ingress. Existing cold restore, multi-account, supervision and synchronous QR/source fencing tests pass. Existing fake adapters mechanically forward renamed shared callbacks.

Generic runtime/outbound/lifecycle implementation complete and focused tests pass. Additional non-WhatsApp execution tests prove opaque tuple identity/delivery scope without a profile and lifecycle acknowledgement on webhook mode. ZAQ mix q passes.

Broad precommit exposed a genuine legacy Discord DM regression: generic open_dm dispatch selected adapters that had not opted into connection_options. Fixed selection to use common scoped open_dm only for adapters implementing connection_options, preserving legacy open_dm_channel behavior. Existing scoped_channel_rating_test unchanged; full relevant file now passes in expanded focused run.

title: [zaq-973.4] Generalize ZAQ runtime, connection options and lifecycle handling
